requirements.text: Minimum Requirements: Master’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Data Science, Quantitative Management, or a closely related field plus two years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation.
Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
Experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, querying databases, and machine learning (2 years);
Experience with statistical analysis, probability, hypothesis testing, parametric & non-parametric tests, and A/B testing frameworks and product analytics (2 years);
Experience with Bayesian Statistics and Mixed Effect Modeling to measure product launches (2 years);
Experience with Causal Inference methods to measure product impact (1 year);
Experience with machine learning and predictive modeling using scikit-learn (1 year);
Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Looker, Plotly, Dash, and Matplotlib/Seaborn for presenting insights (2 years);
Experience handling large-scale datasets using PySpark, Hadoop, or BigQuery (2 years);
Experience with cloud computing, storage, and model deployment on AWS, GCP, or Azure (2 years);
Experience with designing ETL pipelines and working with structured and unstructured data in data warehouses (2 years);
Experience translating data insights into actionable business strategies and communicating findings to stakeholders (2 years).
